chunks.text:
goals

distill definitions: compact, sequentially compact, countably compact, lindelöf, locally compact.
summarize connectedness, path-connectedness, components, local connectedness.
catalogue mit 18.901 applications (heine-borel, tikhonov sketches, bounded continuous functions).

reading cues

munkres ch. 26–31.
mit 18.901 lectures 12–15 (pset 5 focus).

tasks

 prove equivalences between compactness notions in metric spaces (munkres 27.3).
 work through alexandroff one-point compactification examples.
 record connectedness counterexamples (topologist’s sine curve, comb space).
